title: WireSpec
description: Wire conductor specification. Two diameters are always required and must never be conflated. bareD drives resistance and mass; insulatedD drives packing and fit checks.

awg.description: AWG gauge number, or null for custom wire.

bareD.description: Bare copper outer diameter, metres. Use ONLY for resistance (R = ρL/A) and mass calculations.

insulatedD.description: Insulated outer diameter, metres. Use ONLY for packing geometry and U-channel fit checks.

area.description: Bare copper cross-sectional area, m². Must equal π*(bareD/2)². Stored explicitly to avoid repeated computation.
